entry.author: Electricity Authority Te Mana Hiko
entry.summary:
The Electricity Authority Te Mana Hiko is working to ensure we have the right regulatory settings in place to unlock the benefits of battery energy storage systems.

In this webinar we discussed the Wholesale market arrangements for battery energy storage systems (BESS) Code consultation and the Common quality and wholesale market arrangements for BESSs and BESS-hybrid stations – Issues and options paper.
